html.style: width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: block;

body.style: width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: block; background-color: #000; overflow: hidden;

iframe.style: position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; margin: 0; padding: 0;
